Parse pulled JATOS results into jsPsych trial data

Source: R/rawdata-jatos.R
parse_jatos_results.Rd

Repairs and parses the data_raw column of pull_jatos_batches(), one study result at a time, so that one damaged result cannot stop the others.

Usage

parse_jatos_results(x)

Arguments

x

A tibble from pull_jatos_batches(), or any data frame with the columns id_sr and data_raw.

Value

x without data_raw, with three columns added in front:

id

The JATOS study result ID as character; represents the participant identifier used by build_fba_rawdata().

jspsych

A list of tibbles, one row per jsPsych trial, or NULL for a result without parseable data.

has_data

Logical, FALSE on rows where jspsych is NULL.

Attributes of x, such as "retrieved_at", are kept.

Details

A response column is coerced to character for every result. jsPsych records a button press as its index and a choice as text, so a participant whose run holds only button presses, such as one who declined consent, would, without the coercion, get a numeric response column that does not stack with everyone else's.

See also

pull_jatos_batches(), repair_jatos_json()
